title: Tabung Melon
subject: a 3-kilo gas cylinder deliveryman in a Bekasi rusun who carries one up four flights on his shoulder, paid in coins by every tenant and given tea by an old lady on the fourth floor, counting his steps like dance steps
caption: Sri Lankan baila, bouncing 6/8 party groove. Dholak playing the rolling baila pattern, mandolin strumming and picking bright rhythmic figures, trumpet and trombone playing short answering brass riffs, clean rhythm guitar on the offbeat, rounded electric bass, shaker. Bright live party mix, punchy brass, dry dholak. Male vocal, mid register, loud and cheerful, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, A major. Upbeat, cheeky mood. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no distorted guitar, no reggaeton rhythm.
lyrics:
[Intro - dholak, mandolin and brass]

[Verse 1]
Tabung melon di bahu, kakiku mulai berhitung
Lantai satu, satu dua, lantai dua, tiga empat
Tangga rusun sempit, bau sambal di mana-mana
Tiap pintu terbuka, tangan menyodorkan receh

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, naik tangga sambil menari
Tabung melon, tabung melon, jangan jatuh ke kakiku
Satu, dua, tiga, bayar pakai uang logam
Tabung melon, tabung melon, aku kaya recehan

[Verse 2]
Lantai tiga ibu muda bayar dua puluh ribu
Seratusan campur limaratusan, kuhitung ngos-ngosan
Lantai empat nenek Ijah sudah siapkan teh manis
Katanya, Nak, duduk dulu, jangan buru-buru turun

[Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, naik tangga sambil menari
Tabung melon, tabung melon, tehnya masih panas
Satu, dua, tiga, turun lebih ringan
Tabung melon, tabung melon, kantongku bunyi gemerincing

[Outro - dholak, mandolin and brass]
